name: browser-use

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key. Required if MODEL_NAME targets a Claude model.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. Required if MODEL_NAME targets a GPT model.

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Google AI Studio key. Required if MODEL_NAME targets Gemini.

MODEL_NAME.description: LLM driving the browser. Defaults to claude-sonnet-4-6.

HEADLESS.description: Set to 'false' to render the Playwright browser. Defaults to true.

notes: Generic LLM-driven Playwright agent. Defaults to MONITOR — every browser action is reviewed before execution since the agent can authenticate, transact, and submit forms. WebArena: 39.2 (2026-03-04).
